barbell-hip-thrust.note: Right movement. Start hips down, finish hips up. Source frame 2 was a double-line trace, joined into single lines.

dumbbell-hip-thrust.note: Right movement. Start hips down, finish hips up. Source frame 2 dropped: a double-line trace that stayed speckled after clean-up.

dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.note: Right movement. Start standing, finish hinged. Source frame 2 dropped: a different, smaller figure.

single-leg-romanian-deadlift.note: Right movement. Start standing, finish hinged with the leg back. Source frames 3 and 2 were thin double-line traces, joined and smoothed; their lines are a little less even than frame 1.

dumbbell-curtsy-lunge.note: Right movement. Start standing, finish in the lunge. Source frame 2 was a double-line trace, joined.

dumbbell-reverse-lunge.note: Right movement. Start standing, finish in the lunge. Source frame 2 dropped: drawn heavier and larger than the other two.

dumbbell-sumo-squat.note: Right movement. Start standing wide, finish in the squat. Source frame 2 dropped: a smaller figure than the other two.

step-up-onto-bench.note: Right movement. Start with one foot on the bench, finish standing tall. Source frame 2 dropped: drawn heavy, blotched when thinned.

cable-kickback.note: Right movement, with an ankle strap at a low cable. Start standing, finish with the leg back. Source frame 2 dropped: a larger figure.

cable-pull-through.note: Right movement. Start hinged with the hands between the legs, finish standing. The weight-stack machine is erased from both frames (the workouts use the cable on a rack); the cable is kept. Source frame 3 was a thin double-line trace, joined and smoothed. Source frame 2 dropped: the same pose as frame 1.

cable-hip-abduction.note: Right movement, ankle strap at a low pulley. Start standing, finish with the leg out. The standing figure is source frame 3 (a thin trace, joined and smoothed) with the machine of frame 1 pasted in, so the machine is the same in both frames. Source frame 2 dropped: rough.

banded-lateral-walk.note: Right movement. Start feet close, finish stepped out wide. All three source frames match.

banded-clamshell.note: Right movement. Start knees together, finish top knee raised. All three source frames used.

banded-glute-bridge.note: Near match accepted by the brief: the band is not drawn. Start hips down, finish hips up. Source frame 1 dropped: a smaller figure.

single-leg-glute-bridge.note: Right movement. The two clean source frames are close together, so the loop is a small rise of the hips. Source frame 3 (hips fully down) dropped: a rough trace that stayed blotchy after clean-up.

frog-pump.note: Right movement. The source frames differ only slightly, as the movement is small. Source frame 3 was a double-line trace, joined. Source frame 2 dropped: nearly the same as frame 1.

landmine-squat.note: Right movement. Start in a half squat, finish in the deep squat. Source frame 3 (standing) dropped: a thin trace that stayed uneven after clean-up.

goblet-squat.note: Right movement. Start standing, finish in the squat. All three source frames match; two are moved so the feet stay on one floor line.

heel-elevated-goblet-squat.note: Right movement, heels on wedges. Start standing, finish in the squat. All three source frames used.

dumbbell-split-squat.note: Right movement: both feet on the floor, not a Bulgarian split squat. Start tall in the split stance, finish at the bottom. All three source frames used.

dumbbell-walking-lunge.note: Right movement. Taken from the Everkinetic drawing of the walking dumbbell lunge, which frame 1 of the Workout Guide walking-lunge was traced from: the other two Workout Guide frames are different views at a different size and make no loop with it. Start tall, finish in the lunge one step forward.

dumbbell-lateral-lunge.note: Right movement. Start standing, finish in the side lunge. Source frame 3 was a thin double-line trace, joined and smoothed. Source frame 1 dropped: a smaller figure lunging the other way.

leg-extension.note: Right movement. Start legs down, finish extended. The machine base and floor lines are erased from source frames 2 and 1 because frame 3 has none; frame 1 is enlarged 10% to match the others.

calf-raise.note: Near match accepted by the brief: drawn without dumbbells, holding a frame. Start heels down, finish on the toes; the movement is small. Source frame 3 was a double-line trace, joined. Source frame 2 dropped: between the two.

seated-dumbbell-shoulder-press.note: Right movement. Start at the shoulders, finish overhead. Source frame 3 was a thin double-line trace, joined and smoothed. Source frame 2 dropped: nearly the same pose as frame 3, and rougher.

arnold-press.note: Right movement. Start with the dumbbells at head height, finish overhead. Source frame 3 dropped: a rough trace.

landmine-press.note: Right movement, one arm. Start at the shoulder, finish pressed. Source frame 3 lightly cleaned. Source frame 2 dropped: a double-line trace of nearly the same pose.

dumbbell-lateral-raise.note: Right movement. Start arms down, finish arms out. Source frame 2 dropped: drawn very heavy, blotched when thinned.

dumbbell-upright-row.note: Right movement, with dumbbells. The Everkinetic two-frame dumbbell drawing, as the brief allows: it sits well beside the rest. The Workout Guide upright-row uses a barbell.

plate-around-the-world.note: The fallback the brief names: the Workout Guide plate-front-raise. No free drawing of this movement exists, and adapting the figure needs new arms drawn from the shoulders, which could not be done to the standard of the other drawings. Start plate at the hips, finish plate raised in front.

cable-face-pull.note: Right movement. Start arms out, finish pulled to the face. The weight-stack machine is erased from both frames; the cable is kept. Source frame 2 was a thin double-line trace, joined and smoothed. Source frame 3 dropped: rough.

rope-triceps-pushdown.note: Right movement. Start hands at the chest, finish pressed down. Source frame 2 dropped: drawn very heavy, blotched when thinned.

overhead-rope-triceps-extension.note: Right movement. The weight-stack machine is erased; the cable is kept. The two usable frames are close together, so the loop shows only the first part of the extension. Source frame 3 (arms straight) dropped: a rough trace that stayed blotchy after clean-up.

overhead-dumbbell-triceps-extension.note: Right movement, seated. Start arms straight, finish lowered behind the head. Source frame 2 dropped: drawn heavier, slightly blotched.

dumbbell-skull-crusher.note: Right movement. Start arms straight, finish lowered beside the head. Source frame 2 dropped: drawn very heavy, blotched when thinned.

dumbbell-triceps-kickback.note: Right movement, one hand on the bench. Start arm bent, finish arm straight back. All three source frames used.

wide-grip-lat-pulldown.note: Right movement, drawn on a pulldown station with a seat; the workouts use the high pulley of a rack. Start bar at head height, finish pulled lower. The weight stack is erased from both frames (it stayed speckled in frame 2). Source frame 2 was a double-line trace, joined. Source frame 3 (arms straight) dropped: too thin and broken to redraw cleanly.

close-grip-lat-pulldown.note: Near match: drawn with one V handle; the workouts use a single handle in each hand. Start arms up, finish pulled down. Source frame 2 dropped: a larger figure.

straight-arm-pulldown.note: Right movement. Start arms up, finish arms at the thighs. All three source frames used.

seated-cable-row.note: Right movement: sitting low at a low pulley. Start arms out, finish pulled in. All three source frames used; frame 1 is enlarged 10% to match the others.

one-arm-dumbbell-row.note: Right movement. Start arm down, finish pulled up. All three source frames match.

bent-over-dumbbell-row.note: Right movement. Start arms down, finish pulled up. All three source frames match.

landmine-one-arm-row.note: Right movement: the bar itself is gripped, as drawn. Start bar down, finish pulled up. Source frame 3 was a double-line trace, joined and smoothed. Source frame 2 dropped: rough.

bent-over-rear-delt-raise.note: Right movement. Start dumbbells down, finish arms out. Source frame 2 dropped: a rough double-line trace.

prone-y-raise.note: Near match: drawn lying on the floor without dumbbells; the workouts do it face down on an incline bench with light ones. Start arms out low, finish raised in a Y. Source frame 3 dropped: a different view.

superman.note: Right movement. Start lying flat, finish arms and legs raised. Source frame 2 dropped: too thin to redraw cleanly.
